staticText: Local-first English–Igbo phrasebook with exactly 129 embedded app-local draft records. A route-level review corrected distinct understand/not-understand and hospital/pharmacy entries, restored core dot-below vowels, and added tone, vowel-harmony, medical, and dialect boundaries. The inventory still has no entry-level source ledger or qualified-speaker sign-off. Optional uncached cloud machine translation requires explicit, non-persistent page-session consent.
boundaries: Preserve dot-below vowels, tone marks, spelling, apostrophes, and punctuation exactly where supplied.
Tone marking, pronunciation cues, and dialect coverage are incomplete; Standard Igbo wording does not cover every community.
The reviewed local records are not a dictionary, medical translation service, or qualified-speaker certification.
Central Igbo, Onitsha, Nsukka, Enuani, Ikwerre, and other community usage can vary. Do not claim exhaustive or human-quality translation.
Never place raw source or translated text in storage, URLs, analytics, accounts, email, logs, or caches.
